thread:
rita_ops: Seeing 30-120ms east-west spikes between gnode-3a and gnode-3b during the 11:45-12:05 batching window. Batch tail latency up, hosts blown past SLO. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

alex_g: Yep. p99 inter-host latency jumped from ~1.2ms to ~75ms at 11:47. pkt loss small-ish (~0.2%) but retransmits and RDMA retries way up. Correlates w/ peak batching QPS.

cheng_infra: Do we know if traffic is over TCP or using RDMA (verbs)? Our KV prefetch uses RDMA in that zone.

rita_ops: We see both. Some RPCs are RDMA, others fall back to TCP. Quick run: `ibstat` shows link up, but `ibv_devinfo` reports async errors on hfi1_0. Also `ethtool -S ena0` on gnode-3b shows tx_fifo_errors incrementing.

infra-monitor-bot: [alert] 11:46 UTC - east-west jitter anomaly detected on cluster/zone-a. Top metrics: inter-host p99 latency, ib_retries, netdev_tx_errors.

sasha_oncall: Any MTU mismatches in the fleet? Jumbo frames mismatch burned us before.

alex_g: Good call. Ran quick check: gnode-3a mtu=9000, gnode-3b mtu=1500. Oops. New nodes from last week were provisioned with default 1500.

rita_ops: That would cause fragmentation/encapsulation fallback across our vSwitch and cause CPU pathing. Might explain RDMA fallback and higher latency.

cheng_infra: Also seeing ECMP rebalancing around 11:46 -> many flows hit a different spine path. When MTU mismatch + ECMP you can get out-of-order and retransmit storms.

alex_g: Quick experiment: temporarily set gnode-3b mtu 9000 and disable GRO/TSO on the affected hosts to force smaller packets. `sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000` then `ethtool -K eth0 gro off tso off gso off`.

rita_ops: After setting MTU to 9000 on gnode-3b, p99 dropped to ~3.5ms within 60s. RDMA retries decreased. Looks promising.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rolling config change to align MTU across zone-a nodes at 12:15 UTC. Non-disruptive, 10 nodes at a time.

alex_g: Noted driver/firmware variance too: some hosts have ena driver 2.3.4, others 2.5.1. We'll standardize. Ticketing: INFRA-4189.

cheng_infra: Long-term: add an onboarding check to ensure MTU + RDMA config templates applied during node provisioning. Also add a circuit-breaker that detects MTU mismatch and quarantines node from batch pools.

rita_ops: Action list: 1) rollout MTU fix (deploy-bot) 2) standardize NIC driver/firmware (alex_g) 3) add onboarding check (cheng_infra) 4) add metric alert for inter-host mtu mismatch (sasha_oncall).

alex_g: I'll take driver/firmware. Will coordinate with hw-ops for safe window.

cheng_infra: I'll start a small probe job that simulates heavy batching to validate after fixes.

rita_ops: Thanks all — rolling out now. Will monitor for next batching window at 12:45. :thumbsup:

infra-monitor-bot: [resolve] 12:10 UTC - anomaly mitigated after MTU alignment on affected hosts. Continued monitoring enabled.
